emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 4.0.10 (b7dc6e5747465580df5984e723b9d1f10d8e804b)
scope: Private memory-only ICC inspection; explicit RGB source/destination transforms over RGBA uint8, uint16 and float32 windows; explicit RGB/CMYK-device proofing over those native sample formats; legacy sRGB8 delivery and proofing. Separate source/output/proof intent and black-point compensation; same-format alpha copied unchanged and cross-format alpha normalized/quantized. No filesystem, network, native plugins, threads or shared memory. This does not implement high-precision scene editing or CMYK delivery.
